g.text: sphinx-asr: YAML configuration model and the code that consumes it
train.dict : path (optional override, rel. to SPHINX_ROOT)
(applied last, but only for keys present in the template)
dict : path rel. to corpus dir
lm : path rel. to corpus dir
"utt start end text" lines, fillers kept,
load_experiment() expands every TrainEntry into one
{name, split, _corpus} row per split, and validates each
split name against corpus.yml. There is no JSON anywhere:
YAML is the only experiment/config format.
FINDING: "sphinx feats" builds each corpus's .mfc with that corpus's own
rate and filterbank, but setup takes CMN, sample rate, filterbank values,
feat.params and the default dict from train.corpora[0] only. Mixing
LibriSpeech (25 filters, 16 kHz) with Switchboard (15 filters, 8 kHz), as
the README example shows, trains on mixed filterbank features under one
config. (The README example's splits "145hr"/"300hr" also do not exist;
